LanguageData.VCE_Apparel_WarmHat.description: A warm, fluffy, thick cap. Ideal for keeping warm in winter.
LanguageData.VCE_Apparel_WarmHat.label: warm hat
LanguageData.VCE_Apparel_WarmJacket.description: A cozy, thick and fluffy jacket for staying warm even in the coldest of temperatures.
LanguageData.VCE_Apparel_WarmJacket.label: warm jacket
LanguageData.VCE_Bullet_Snowthrower.label: snowball
LanguageData.VCE_Eggnog.description: A rich, creamy holiday drink made from milk, eggs, and sugar, often spiced with nutmeg. Eggnog is sweet and comforting, but its festive charm is enhanced when spiked with alcohol, leading to warmth—and potential overindulgence.
LanguageData.VCE_Eggnog.label: eggnog
LanguageData.VCE_FairyLamps.description: A wall-mounted string of lamps that light up a small area using electricity. It is much less powerful than a standing lamp, but can be mounted on walls.
LanguageData.VCE_FairyLamps.label: fairy lamps
LanguageData.VCE_FestiveCracker.description: A small package of plastic waste and candy. When pulled apart, sprays confetti, bringing festive joy to everyone.
LanguageData.VCE_FestiveCracker.label: festive cracker
LanguageData.VCE_FestiveJukebox.description: A classic music-playing device equipped with colorful lights and a selection of timeless festive tracks. Even on the rimworlds, a jukebox can fill the room with lively tunes or jolly melodies to lift the spirits.
LanguageData.VCE_FestiveJukebox.label: festive jukebox
LanguageData.VCE_FestivePresent.description: A festive present. Depending on the quality, it may contain valuable items or resources, or complete garbage.
LanguageData.VCE_FestivePresent.label: festive present
LanguageData.VCE_FestivePresentProjectile.label: festive present
LanguageData.VCE_FestiveRug_Broad.description: A festive rug with a wintery pattern, for decorating a floor.
LanguageData.VCE_FestiveRug_Broad.label: festive rug (broad)
LanguageData.VCE_FestiveRug_Medium.description: A festive rug with a wintery pattern, for decorating a floor.
LanguageData.VCE_FestiveRug_Medium.label: festive rug (medium)
LanguageData.VCE_FestivityBaby.description: A torso-sized piece of material sculpted into an artistic form, depicting a festive baby in a crib. Placing all pieces of the festivity scene next to each other is bound to greatly increase their beauty.
LanguageData.VCE_FestivityBaby.label: festivity baby
LanguageData.VCE_FestivityDonkey.description: A person-sized piece of material sculpted into an artistic form, depicting a festive donkey kneeling with reverence. Placing all pieces of the festivity scene next to each other is bound to greatly increase their beauty.
LanguageData.VCE_FestivityDonkey.label: festivity donkey
LanguageData.VCE_FestivityFather.description: A person-sized piece of material sculpted into an artistic form, depicting a festive father keeping a watchful eye. Placing all pieces of the festivity scene next to each other is bound to greatly increase their beauty.
LanguageData.VCE_FestivityFather.label: festivity father
LanguageData.VCE_FestivityHunter.description: A person-sized piece of material sculpted into an artistic form, depicting a festive hunter submitting his hard work as tithe. Placing all pieces of the festivity scene next to each other is bound to greatly increase their beauty.
LanguageData.VCE_FestivityHunter.label: festivity hunter
LanguageData.VCE_FestivityKing.description: A person-sized piece of material sculpted into an artistic form, depicting a festive king bending his knee. Placing all pieces of the festivity scene next to each other is bound to greatly increase their beauty.
LanguageData.VCE_FestivityKing.label: festivity king
LanguageData.VCE_FestivityMother.description: A person-sized piece of material sculpted into an artistic form, depicting a festive mother kneeling on the floor with a loving expression. Placing all pieces of the festivity scene next to each other is bound to greatly increase their beauty.
LanguageData.VCE_FestivityMother.label: festivity mother
LanguageData.VCE_FestivityOx.description: A person-sized piece of material sculpted into an artistic form, depicting a festive ox kneeling with reverence. Placing all pieces of the festivity scene next to each other is bound to greatly increase their beauty.
LanguageData.VCE_FestivityOx.label: festivity ox
LanguageData.VCE_FestivitySheep.description: A person-sized piece of material sculpted into an artistic form, depicting a festive sheep kneeling with reverence. Placing all pieces of the festivity scene next to each other is bound to greatly increase their beauty.
LanguageData.VCE_FestivitySheep.label: festivity sheep
LanguageData.VCE_FestivityShepherd.description: A person-sized piece of material sculpted into an artistic form, depicting a festive shepherd giving away his animals as a gift. Placing all pieces of the festivity scene next to each other is bound to greatly increase their beauty.
LanguageData.VCE_FestivityShepherd.label: festivity shepherd
LanguageData.VCE_Filth_Water.label: water puddle
LanguageData.VCE_GingerRoot.description: A spicy-sweet root with a warm, festive aroma. Ginger root thrives only in the chill of Decembrary and is the key ingredient for creating delicious gingerbread treats.
LanguageData.VCE_GingerRoot.label: ginger root
LanguageData.VCE_Gingerbread.description: Sweet and spicy gingerbread. Can be consumed raw or added as an ingredient in meals, but can also be used to construct sturdy objects with high beauty value.
LanguageData.VCE_Gingerbread.label: gingerbread
LanguageData.VCE_GrandFestiveTree.description: A grand, carefully decorated tree with hundreds of ornaments, chains of lamps and tinsels. Lights up a large area. In Decembrary, grand festive trees contribute towards festive favor greatly, and depending on their quality, generate less or more festive favor every day. It takes a long time to construct a grand festive tree, but once built, decorations can be changed at will.
LanguageData.VCE_GrandFestiveTree.label: grand festive tree
LanguageData.VCE_GunTurret_Snowthrower.description: A portable automatic snowball propelling turret. Requires snow to be delivered to it after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.
LanguageData.VCE_GunTurret_Snowthrower.label: snowthrower
LanguageData.VCE_Gun_SnowcannonTurret.description: A heavy automatic snowball-firing cannon. The sheer amount of snowballs fired will cover a small area in devastating white volley, but it needs to be regularly reloaded with snow to continue firing. It cannot fire at close-up targets, and may explode when damaged.
LanguageData.VCE_Gun_SnowcannonTurret.label: snowcannon
LanguageData.VCE_HotCocoa.description: A comforting and creamy beverage offering a rich chocolate flavor that warms both body and soul. Perfect for cold days or as a delightful treat, it’s a simple yet indulgent classic.
LanguageData.VCE_HotCocoa.label: hot cocoa
LanguageData.VCE_Megareindeer.description: A colossal, herd-dwelling herbivore adapted to the harshest cold environments. The megareindeer boasts enormous, intricately branched antlers used for both display and defense. Originally engineered for arctic survival, it serves as a robust pack animal, capable of carrying heavy loads across frozen landscapes. Its thick, insulated fur is prized for crafting warm clothing. Generally docile, the megareindeer will fiercely maul enemies with its massive antlers if threatened.
LanguageData.VCE_Megareindeer.label: megareindeer
LanguageData.VCE_Megareindeer.tools.0.label: left hoof
LanguageData.VCE_Megareindeer.tools.1.label: right hoof
LanguageData.VCE_Megareindeer.tools.2.label: left hoof
LanguageData.VCE_Megareindeer.tools.3.label: right hoof
LanguageData.VCE_Megareindeer.tools.5.label: head
LanguageData.VCE_MilkAndCookies.description: Sweet and tasty and bound to make anyone happy, this dessert has a tendency to disappear on the morning of December 10th. Fear not, however, as when it disappears, it increases festive favor greatly.
LanguageData.VCE_MilkAndCookies.label: milk and cookies
LanguageData.VCE_Plant_TreeFir.description: A majestic evergreen with soft, flat needles and smooth bark. Its symmetrical silhouette is often admired in alpine forests.
LanguageData.VCE_Plant_TreeFir.label: fir tree
LanguageData.VCE_Plant_TreeJuniper.description: A hardy evergreen shrub or small tree with spiky needles and aromatic berries. It thrives in rocky, arid landscapes.
LanguageData.VCE_Plant_TreeJuniper.label: juniper tree
LanguageData.VCE_Plant_TreeSpruce.description: A tall conifer with dark green needles and densely packed branches. Its slender, conical shape is ideal for cold, snowy climates.
LanguageData.VCE_Plant_TreeSpruce.label: spruce tree
LanguageData.VCE_SantaAerodrone_Crashed.description: A crashed variant of an aerodrone that ships presents across the planet. All the presents have been destroyed upon crashlanding, but it might be possible to obtain some festive crackers upon deconstructing this wreck. This wreck seems to emit some festive music, and due to some psychic influence, spreads snow around itself.
LanguageData.VCE_SantaAerodrone_Crashed.label: crashed present-shipper
LanguageData.VCE_SantaAerodrone_Crashing.description: A variant of an aerodrone that ships presents across the planet.
LanguageData.VCE_SantaAerodrone_Crashing.label: present-shipper
LanguageData.VCE_Snow.description: Compressed frozen water crystals that can be shaped into sturdy structures that will melt and disappear in heat.
LanguageData.VCE_Snow.label: snow
LanguageData.VCE_SnowSculpture.description: A person-sized sculpture out of snow, representing an artistic form of a human being. Whilst it will melt in the summer, it will continuously provide festive favor as long as it’s kept ‘alive’.
LanguageData.VCE_SnowSculpture.label: snow sculpture
LanguageData.VCE_SnowSpewer.description: An advanced climatic manipulator designed for environmental transformation. By extracting atmospheric moisture and seeding it with ultra-cold nano-crystals, the snow spewer blankets entire regions with continuous snowfall, turning any landscape into a frozen wonderland.
LanguageData.VCE_SnowSpewer.label: snow spewer
LanguageData.VCE_StandingFestiveTree.description: A small, decorative tree with a number of festive lights that light up an area. People need light to move and work at full speed.
LanguageData.VCE_StandingFestiveTree.label: standing festive tree
LanguageData.VCE_Toy_Cloth.description: A small plushie toy. When carried by children, helps them create long lasting memories. The impact that such a toy can have depends on the quality of its craftsmanship. It is also widely known that donating toys to those in need is a very festive thing to do.
LanguageData.VCE_Toy_Cloth.label: plushie toy
LanguageData.VCE_Toy_Metal.description: A small metal toy. When carried by children, helps them create long lasting memories. The impact that such a toy can have depends on the quality of its craftsmanship. It is also widely known that donating toys to those in need is a very festive thing to do.
LanguageData.VCE_Toy_Metal.label: metal toy

LanguageData.VCE_Toy_Wooden.label: wooden toy

It cannot fire at close-up targets, and may explode when damaged.
LanguageData.VCE_Turret_Snowcannon.label: Snowcannon
